claim: The fwkdl.EndpointDiscovery interface requires exactly two methods that any custom discovery plugin (K8s or non-K8s) must implement: Start(ctx context.Context, notifier DiscoveryNotifier) error, and (since PR #1218) Ready() <-chan struct{}.
stance_target: the interface contract a custom EndpointDiscovery plugin must satisfy

claim: Ready()'s channel must be closed exactly once, only after a successful initial sync (e.g. first file load or first Kubernetes list+watch reconcile); if Start returns an error before that point, the channel must remain open and callers should also watch for context cancellation.
stance_target: precise Ready() contract a custom discovery plugin implementation must honor
quoted_support:
Contract:
  - The channel is closed at most once per Start invocation.
  - It is closed only after a successful initial sync. If Start returns
    an error before that point, the channel remains open and callers
    waiting on it should also observe ctx cancellation.

claim: When dataLayer.discovery(.endpoints).pluginRef is set, the EPP runner skips Kubernetes controller-manager setup entirely and runs discovery plus the ext_proc/health servers together under a RunnableGroup, gating request-serving (epp-server, health) but not /metrics on the discovery plugin's Ready() channel closing.
stance_target: llm-d-router EPP can run against non-Kubernetes backends when a custom/alternate EndpointDiscovery plugin is wired in
quoted_support: Wire the file-discovery plugin (#1135) into the runner so the EPP can run without a Kubernetes cluster. When dataLayer.discovery.pluginRef is set, the runner skips controller-manager setup, runs discovery + servers under a RunnableGroup, gates request-serving on EndpointDiscovery.Ready(), and warns about K8s-only features that are inactive in this mode.

claim: The reference FileDiscovery plugin satisfies the Ready() contract with a sync.Once-guarded channel closed immediately after its first successful file load, providing a concrete template a custom non-K8s discovery plugin can follow.
stance_target: reference implementation pattern for a custom EndpointDiscovery plugin's Ready() method
